# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 18 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Pharaoh's Son Plots Against Joseph

---

**18:1** And after this the first-born son of Pharaoh heard the words of Simeon and Levi concerning Aseneth, and was filled with grief and envy, and set his heart against Joseph and Aseneth.

**18:2** And he sent a messenger to Dan and Gad, the sons of the handmaids of Jacob, and said to them: 'I know that you are brave men and men of great strength.'

**18:3** 'And behold, I know that you hate Joseph your brother, for he sold you to slavery to the Ishmaelites, and you suffered great toil. Come now to me and I will make you rich and powerful, for I will give you much gold and silver.'

**18:4** 'And I wish to kill Joseph, for he is my enemy, and to take Aseneth as my wife, for she is fitting for me and not for Joseph the son of a slave.'

**18:5** And Dan and Gad said to the firstborn son of Pharaoh: 'We are your servants and will do whatever you command us, for the man who hates our brother Joseph is also our friend.'

**18:6** And Pharaoh's firstborn son said to them: 'My plan is this. Tonight I will go to Pentephres' house and kill him and his wife and take Aseneth as my wife. And you shall go to Joseph and kill him. But take care to kill Joseph's sons also, lest they avenge their father.'

**18:7** And they said to him: 'We will do as you have said.' And the son of Pharaoh took them into his house and feasted with them and drank wine with them.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
